---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples at the end of help totalme, run in full"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

The examples from the end of the [help file](help.html), in order, on the
GSS extract used in Mize and Han (2025).

## Single model

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
use https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/cda_gss, clear

mlogit healthR i.race4 c.age i.woman
<</dd_do>>
```

Continuous and binary independent variables:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
totalme age woman
totalme age woman, amount(sd)
totalme age woman, amount(2sd)
totalme age woman, amount(trimrange)
totalme age woman, amount(range)
totalme age woman, amount(rate)
totalme age woman, start(age=20) amount(10)
<</dd_do>>
```

A nominal independent variable (ME inequalities are calculated on each
outcome):

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
totalme race4
totalme race4, unweighted
<</dd_do>>
```

Total MEs by group, with the **Diff.** row testing whether they differ:

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
totalme age woman, by(race4)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Compare across two models on the same sample

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
mlogit healthR i.college if faminc < ., vce(robust)
est store basemod
mlogit healthR i.college c.faminc, vce(robust)
est store medmod

totalme college, models(basemod medmod)
<</dd_do>>
```

## Compare across distinct samples/groups for two models

```{.stata-run}
<<dd_do>>
ologit class i.college if woman == 0, vce(robust)
est store menmod
ologit class i.college if woman == 1, vce(robust)
est store wommod

totalme college, models(menmod wommod) groups
<</dd_do>>
```

## Bootstrap example

Shown, not run.

```stata
capture program drop boot_tot

program define boot_tot, rclass
    mlogit healthR i.race4 c.age i.woman, base(1)
    totalme race4
    return scalar w_tot = r(tmwm11)
end

bootstrap w_tot=r(w_tot), reps(1000): boot_tot
```
